phase1_contract.input_format: Per-window JSON files OR single .npz file
phase1_contract.alignment: ML1 stores at window t. ML2 adapter fetches t-1 itself via inject_novelty_into_graphs
phase1_contract.slot_10: graph.x[:, 10] (zero-indexed), the 11th feature of each node
phase1_contract.expected_shape: novelty vector of shape [N] for N active hosts per window
phase1_contract.missing_value_behavior: Returns np.zeros(N, dtype=float32) for missing windows
phase1_contract.z_t_usage: Separate 64-dim temporal embedding (currently MOCK zeros in trainer/metrics)
phase1_contract.z_t_note: z_t is NOT the same as slot-10 novelty; z_t is a separate fusion input
